vector<bool> prime(int num) {
    vector<bool> bool_vec(num, true);
    for (int i = 2; i * i < num; i++) {
        if (bool_vec[i]) {
            for (int j = i * i; j < num; j += i) {
                bool_vec[j] = false;
            }
        }
    }
    if (num >= 0) {
        bool_vec[0] = false;
        bool_vec[1] = false;
    }
    return bool_vec;
}

ll modInverse(ll a, ll m) {
    ll result = 1;
    ll base = a % m;
    ll exponent = m - 2;
    while (exponent > 0) {
        if (exponent & 1) {
            result = (result * base) % m;
        }
        base = (base * base) % m;
        exponent >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

class Combinations {
public:
    vector<long long> z, z1, z2;
    long long mod;

    Combinations(long long N, long long mod) {
        this->mod = mod;
        z.resize(N + 1);
        z1.resize(N + 1);
        z2.resize(N + 1);
        z[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) z[i] = (z[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        z2[0] = z2[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++)
            z2[i] = z2[(int)(mod % i)] * (mod - mod / i) % mod;
        z1[0] = z1[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++)
            z1[i] = (z2[i] * z1[i - 1]) % mod;
    }

};

class DisjointUnionSets {
public:
    vector<int> rank, parent;
    int n;

    DisjointUnionSets(int n) {
        rank.resize(n);
        parent.resize(n);
        this->n = n;
        makeSet();
    }

    void makeSet() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            parent[i] = i;
        }
    }

    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) {
            parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        }
        return parent[x];
    }

    void union(int x, int y) {
        int xRoot = find(x), yRoot = find(y);
        if (xRoot == yRoot) return;
        if (rank[xRoot] < rank[yRoot])
            parent[xRoot] = yRoot;
        else if (rank[yRoot] < rank[xRoot])
            parent[yRoot] = xRoot;
        else {
            parent[yRoot] = xRoot;
            rank[xRoot] = rank[xRoot] + 1;
        }
    }
};

vector<int> KMP(string str) {
    int n = str.length();
    vector<int> kmp(n, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = kmp[i - 1];
        while (j > 0 && str[i] != str[j]) {
            j = kmp[j - 1];
        }
        if (str[i] == str[j]) j++;
        kmp[i] = j;
    }
    return kmp;
}

class SparseTable {
private:
    vector<vector<long long>> st;
    vector<int> log;

public:
    SparseTable(vector<long long>& arr) {
        int n = arr.size();
        st.resize(n, vector<long long>(25));
        log.resize(n + 2);
        build_log(n + 1);
        build(arr);
    }

    void build(vector<long long>& arr) {
        int n = arr.size();
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 25; j++) {
                int r = i + (1 << j) - 1;
                if (r >= n) break;
                if (j == 0) st[i][j] = arr[i];
                else st[i][j] = min(st[i][j - 1], st[i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }

    long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
        if (a == 0) return b;
        return gcd(b % a, a);
    }

    long long query(int l, int r) {
        int w = r - l + 1;
        int power = log[w];
        return min(st[l][power], st[r - (1 << power) + 1][power]);
    }

    void build_log(int n) {
        log[1] = 0;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            log[i] = 1 + log[i / 2];
        }
    }
};

ll back(vector<char>& arr) {

void TEST_CASE() {

        if (arr[0] == '0' || arr[0] == '_' || arr[0] == 'X') {
            cout << "1\n";

            cout << "0\n";

        cout << "0\n";
        return;

    bool hasX = false;
    for (char cc : arr) {
        if (cc == 'X') {
            hasX = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    ll tot = 0;
    if (hasX) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            vector<char> temp = arr;
            if (temp[0] == 'X' && i == 0) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (temp[j] == 'X') {
                    temp[j] = (char)(i + '0');
                }
            }
            flag = false;
            ll back_val = back(temp);
            ll pre = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < n - 2; j++) {
                if (temp[j] == '_') {
                    if (j == 0) pre *= 9;
                    else pre *= 10;
                }
            }
            tot += pre * back_val;
            if (pre == 1 && flag) {
                tot--;
            }
        }
    } else {
        flag = false;
        ll back_val = back(arr);
        ll pre = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < n - 2; j++) {
            if (arr[j] == '_') {
                if (j == 0) pre *= 9;
                else pre *= 10;
            }
        }
        tot += pre * back_val;
        if (pre == 1 && flag) {
            tot--;
        }
    }

    cout << tot << "\n";
}
